dynamic_plugins.exposure: public functions defined in declared schema-2 entrypoint; legacy plugins retain old scan behavior
dynamic_plugins.failure_mode: last-known-good remains active until a valid refresh loads

integrity_recovery.task_lineage: reconcile surviving IDs/UUIDs, then nearest validated-history ancestor, else detach safely
integrity_recovery.memory_threads: preserve intact links, remap from source messages, then conservatively cluster remaining orphans
integrity_recovery.prune_safety: reparent surviving children and preserve memory-thread links before destructive history pruning

external_workspace.state_root: config/settings.ini:[paths].state_root (trusted Norm runtime state; not a tool root unless explicitly added)

modes.source: package-managed source/docs/built-in plugins only; no secrets/private runtime state
modes.full: source plus all plugins, .ssh, configured secrets, workspace, selected recovery/log/state, and PostgreSQL

canonical_prompt_ingress.invariant: accepted normal prompt must produce a durable task_id before ingress is acknowledged

startup_reliability.startup_resource_boundary: activity API, worker, chat API, and their threads are released on every startup exit/failure before retry
startup_reliability.postgres_retry_boundary: normal startup performs PostgreSQL connection/schema initialization inside the bounded three-attempt psycopg retry loop
startup_reliability.plugin_concurrency: hydration, schema refresh, and execution are serialized by one process-global reentrant lock

large_source_processing.ceiling_behavior: checkpoint + suppress/park same task; manual resume resets per-pass counter
large_source_processing.terminal_cleanup: delete reproducible task-local derivatives; retain source/recipe lineage and internal Markdown notes

ingrained_details.primary_rule: confidently classified details go directly to their final durable home
ingrained_details.trial_policy: test a few plausible bits against later tasks; preserve trial outcomes while unresolved
ingrained_details.resolved_cleanup: delete temporary unresolved row and its cascade trial history after final-home promotion
ingrained_details.queue_status: DB3 prompt_id is carried into durable task provenance so /queue can show current task/step instead of only a prompt prefix

windows_launcher.service_host: headless CREATE_NO_WINDOW + SW_HIDE; existing shutdown lifecycle owns process exit
windows_launcher.runtime_console: prefer dedicated Windows Terminal wt.exe window; classic console fallback

pdf_vision_parse.authority: rendered page over untrusted text layer
pdf_vision_parse.delivery: checksum-first managed plugin reconciliation; verified src is untouched, mismatched Norm src is repaired before any public fallback

model_stream_safety.behavior: publish upstream Ollama answer/thinking fragments immediately; repetition guard/crash buffering remain independent

operator_network_map.active_probe_policy: explicit config/network-map.json targets only; discovered peers never widen targets

runtime_summary.semantics: end-of-task current-state projection, not historical supersession ledger
runtime_summary.same_turn_order: durable memory extraction/supersession before summary refresh
runtime_summary.failure_mode: retry one whole-state rebuild, then deterministic current-state fallback; never freeze stale prior summary
runtime_summary.generation_stream: silent while structured JSON is generated
runtime_summary.operator_output: publish one complete End-of-task durable summary event after successful/fallback persistence
runtime_summary.execution_request: conservative exact-span sidecar removal only; embedded task qualifiers remain verbatim

public_optional_plugins.ownership: checksum-first managed adapter: verify src before writes; matching src is untouched while trusted plugin.json/README metadata may refresh; mismatched Norm-owned src is repaired; non-src plugin state is preserved
public_optional_plugins.source: public Norm source package / plugin repository

public_plugin_install.policy: hash installed managed plugin src first; if target SHA matches, leave src untouched and refresh only changed trusted metadata; otherwise repair Norm src from packaged release, re-hash, then use pinned public source only if packaged repair still fails; missing plugins prefer public source
public_plugin_install.verification: exact trusted Schema-2 name/version/entrypoint/src-tree SHA; verification always precedes writes; public source is a second repair path and fresh-install source

plugin_settings.reconcile: startup and every PluginManager refresh/hot-swap; preserve declared operator values, fill missing/invalid values from defaults, prune dangling keys/sections after backup
plugin_settings.secrets: external environment/secrets file only; never plugins.ini

plugin_configuration.absent_behavior: Jan, Vane, OpenCode, and shared model-provider routing are disabled; existing Norm/Ollama behavior is unchanged
plugin_configuration.legacy_migration: Installer 1.6.10 migrates any 1.6.9 model_provider/remote_agents sections out of settings.ini and removes them from the core config

backup_retention.semantics: 12 newest backup sets per backup class/location; a backup ZIP plus its .sha256 companion counts as one set

n1_control_loop.flow: user -> N1 ingress review -> N2 -> N1 tool gate/reuse -> N2 -> N1 final review -> user
n1_control_loop.ingress: N1 may attach advisory guidance but cannot rewrite or block the exact user turn
n1_control_loop.routing: N2 proposes subject decomposition/thread placement; N1 accepts or retries before persistence
n1_control_loop.tool_gate: N1 may execute, reuse verified evidence, or block repeated identical paths
n1_control_loop.final: N1 accepts/retries; N2 performs any repair; N1 does not rewrite the final answer

subject_routing.existing_thread_policy: reuse only at confidence >= threshold; otherwise create a better subject thread or clarify
subject_routing.assistant_projection: verbatim excerpts only; failure falls back to primary thread only
